D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/EffectProbabili.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.EffectProbabilityExtension.effect_density_representation
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/EffectProbabili.signature: theorem effect_density_representation {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (p : CStarMatrix d d ℂ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ E, 0 ≤ E → E ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ p E) (hadd : ∀ E F, 0 ≤ E → 0 ≤ F → E + F ≤ 1 → p (E + F) = p E + p F) (hnorm : p 1 = 1) : ∃! ρ : Matrix d d ℂ, ρ.PosSemidef ∧ Matrix.trace ρ = 1 ∧ ∀ E : CStarMatrix d d ℂ, 0 ≤ E → E ≤ 1 → Matrix.trace (ρ * CStarMatrix.ofMatrix.symm E) = (p E : ℂ)

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/EffectProbabili.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.EffectProbabilityExtension.effect_trace_unique
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/EffectProbabili.signature: theorem effect_trace_unique {d : Type*} [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (ρ σ : Matrix d d ℂ) (h : ∀ E : CStarMatrix d d ℂ, 0 ≤ E → E ≤ 1 → pairing ρ E = pairing σ E) : ρ = σ
